core_obligations: Pass to the perfect closure, which is algebraically closed by hypothesis, and extend scalars (proof lines 11330-11340).

Show the fibres are irreducible in the algebraically closed case, and conclude irreducibility of the tensor product by the criterion for flat ring maps with irreducible fibres (proof lines 11340-11359).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to an algebraically closed base by the perfect closure (proof lines 11329-11340).
Use the fibre criterion to descend irreducibility (proof lines 11340-11360).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that over a separably closed field the tensor product of two algebras each having a unique minimal prime again has a unique minimal prime (statement lines 11322-11327). The proof does not argue with minimal primes directly: it passes to the perfect closure, which is algebraically closed under the hypothesis, proves irreducibility of the fibres in that case, and applies the criterion for flat ring maps with irreducible fibres to the tensor product (proof lines 11329-11360). Passing to the perfect closure so that the field becomes algebraically closed is the step that simplifies the geometry. H2.
